purpose.zh: 练核心，让身体在移动时也不被拉转
purpose.en: Train your core to keep your body from turning while you step.

text.zh: 手臂伸直在胸前，身体一直朝前
text.en: Keep your arms straight in front and your body facing forward

text.zh: 两只脚一只一只往外迈，再一只一只收回。
text.en: Step your feet out one at a time, then back in one at a time.
Keep your knees soft and keep breathing.

commonErrors.en: Letting your body turn toward the anchor.
Stepping so wide that your posture breaks.

cautions.zh: 固定点不牢时先别开始
cautions.en: Do not start until the anchor is secure.

cautions.zh: 地面湿滑或周围有障碍时别做
cautions.en: Do not do this on a slippery floor or near obstacles.

changes: 节奏按 spec 关键帧手算：一下 = 两脚依次外迈 2.2 s、站宽停 1.6 s、两脚依次收回 2.6 s（派生轨道 step 只读到一只脚，算成 5 s 保持）
口令改成「两脚外迈 / 两脚收回」与动画一致
